Standard: The minimum light intensities in all vertical planes, measured with the red filter (if used) is expressed in terms of effective intensities. The following relation is assumed: 𝐼𝐼𝑒𝑒 = ∫ 𝐼𝐼(𝑡𝑡)𝑑𝑑𝑑𝑑 𝑡𝑡2 𝑡𝑡1 0.2 + (𝑡𝑡2 − 𝑡𝑡1) Ie = effective intensity(cd) I(t) = instantaneous intensity as a function of time t2 – t1 = flash time interval Each anticollision light effective intensity is equal or exceeds the applicable values in TABLE VII. TABLE VII. Minimum effective intensity. Angle Above or Below the Horizontal Plane Effective Intensity (cd) Fixed-Wing Effective Intensity (cd) Rotary-Wing 0 to 5 degrees 400 150 5 to 10 degrees 240 90 10 to 20 degrees 80 30 20 to 30 degrees 40 15 30 to 75 degrees 20 N/A Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Effective intensity is measured in ground testing.
